label: TRIAL real run: owner-retargeted Mixamo Gaming capture, all 152 captured frames

audit.algorithm: Aligned world rest delta; QtargetWorld=C QsrcWorld inverse(QsrcRestWorld) inverse(C) QtargetRestWorld

clip.source_fbx_sha256_basis: declared by root for the private owner Mixamo download (raw FBX not in Git)

seated.rule: both thighs >= 55 deg from vertical in every sampled frame

contact_rule.distance: exact point-triangle distance, inside by generalized winding number

ik_proposal.rule: left two-bone IK (LeftArm/LeftForeArm), wrist WORLD orientation and finger locals preserved; the remaining wrist rotation is reported as a residual, never forced

bounded_two_arm_ik.rule: bounded two-arm two-bone IK; hand+fingers rigid (captured finger locals exact); wrist world orientation changed only by the per-hand grip mismatch; proposal and residuals only

ue_contract: UE component cm = 100 * (x, z, y) of glTF metres (export_seat_fit_source.py contract); the offset in UE is P X P^-1 with P = that axis swap, translation x100; unverified for the static-mesh import until root's receipt.
